rules: Use Manrope for all Headings (H1-H6) with tracking-tight. NEVER use Inter for headings.
Use IBM Plex Sans for body text to ensure excellent Vietnamese character legibility and technical density.
Use JetBrains Mono for Timecodes, Shot IDs, and Version numbers to ensure exact alignment.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-800/80 on all cards and sidebars to define hierarchy without shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on surface colors and 1px borders instead of drop shadows. Use subtle shadow-lg only for dropdowns and popovers.
visual_enhancers.radii: Small and precise: rounded-md (6px) for inner elements (buttons, pills), rounded-lg (8px) for cards/panels.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for sticky headers or review overlays: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#09090b]/80 border-b border-zinc-800.

layouts.app_shell: Linear-inspired shell. Collapsible left sidebar (w-64) with dense tree navigation. Main canvas takes remaining width. Sticky top header for contextual actions.
layouts.spacing: Dense 'Bento' and List Grids. Use p-4 or p-6 for containers. Use gap-2 or gap-4 for dense data rows. Do not use excessive whitespace as this is a professional workspace.
layouts.data_density: High. Use compact table rows (h-10 or h-12) and clear column alignments.
layouts.panels: Use slide-over (Sheet) from the right side for Shot Detail, Version Upload, and Review Feedback to keep the user in context.

components.tree_navigation: Sidebar tree for Sequence > Scene > Shot. Use chevron icons, distinct indentation (pl-4 per level), and hover highlight states.
components.video_player_review: Custom wrapper with absolute positioned Timecode markers on the progress bar. Use transparent overlay for drawing/feedback.
components.script_diff_view: Split or inline diff. Added text: bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-200. Removed text: line-through bg-red-500/20 text-red-200.
components.kanban_board: For assignments. Strict columns (To Do, In Progress, Review, Done). Minimal gap between cards (gap-2), thin borders.

motion.interactions: Fast and snappy. transition-colors duration-150 for hovers. transition-all duration-200 ease-out for slide-overs.
motion.lists: Subtle stagger entrance for lists and kanban boards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG 2.2 AA (minimum 4.5:1). Dark theme with high contrast text.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-version-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use .js and .jsx for all React components. Do NOT use .tsx files.
Build a production-grade, dark-mode only (or default dark) layout similar to Frame.io and Linear.
Never use generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment and grid-based left alignments for dense data.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals; always use solid dark backgrounds with 1px borders.
For avatars and missing images, use the provided image_urls. Do not use text placeholders.
Ensure Vietnamese language strings are correctly rendered. Do not break text layout with long Vietnamese words.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and actionable rows to support QA testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Make the UI feel like an expensive, professional film tool.
Do not add universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add explicit transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Do not center align the app container. Text alignment must follow natural reading flow (left-aligned).
Never use AI assistant Emojis. Use Lucide or Phosphor icons for professional toolography.
Use layered elements (z-index) to create depth. Utilize nested container borders.
Prioritize pre-existing Shadcn components where applicable.
